build.reason: The supplied recipe builds and links the xinclude target from xinclude.o and fuzz.o; the new setter is declared and defined, and the OLD target has no new link dependency on it. This assesses the recipe and symbols, not an observed build result.

input.reason: The entry accepts finite bytes for options, allocation limit and URL/body pairs. A first entity containing valid XML with an XInclude element and an invalid parse value can reach an XInclude error without an environment failure.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines finite string encoding and termination.
Makes the first URL/body pair the main document.
An invalid parse value generates an XInclude error.

lifecycle.reason: For a parsed document, the entry creates the context, processes it, frees it before freeing the document, and then cleans up input state. Null context and null document cases are guarded by the source functions.

evidence.dependency_reason: Context creation rejects a null document and zeroes context state.
Context cleanup accepts null and releases owned state.

control_flow.reason: A parsed document reaches xmlXIncludeProcessNode, root processing, document traversal, XInclude recognition and error reporting. The missing callback configuration is assessed separately as the frozen blocker.

evidence.dependency_reason: Dispatches the target call to root processing.
Dispatches root processing to document traversal.
Traversal recognizes and expands XInclude nodes.
Recognizes XInclude elements and can report an input-driven error.

assessment.requirement: The XInclude-context operation must make the supported context-specific structured error callback and its data reachable for XInclude errors and their delegated parser and XPointer paths.
assessment.target_route: Finite input supplies a main XML document containing an XInclude element. The entry parses it, creates an xmlXIncludeCtxt, sets flags and calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode. XInclude traversal can report errors; included-document parsing and XPointer evaluation use the same context callback when configured.
assessment.failure_condition: The OLD entry never calls xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler. xmlXIncludeNewContext zeroes errorHandler and errorCtxt, so no fuzz input can cause this context to deliver errors through its own configured callback and data.
assessment.alternative_paths: The initializer installs only a generic error function. Input bytes control options and entities, not the context's callback fields. The reader pass creates no callback on the XInclude context. A global error route cannot supply this context-specific callback and data.
